billing.heading: Billing details
billing.hint: Not needed for the trial — fill them in before ordering a plan. They appear on invoices.

membership.heading: Plan & payment
membership.hintActive: Your membership is active. The plans are listed below; we'll arrange a plan change with you by e-mail.
membership.hintTrial: Your trial runs until {{date}}. Choose a plan and payment method — your data and address stay unchanged.

cloud-lite: Backups and updates handled by us
cloud-pro: A dedicated server just for you
cloud-ai-agent: Everything in KB Cloud Pro on a stronger server
Hermes agent works through tasks from your map (on your AI key)

membership.yearFree: A year = 10 monthly payments, 2 months free.
membership.cardUnavailable: Card payment is coming soon — please use bank transfer (yearly) or contact support@killbottleneck.com.
membership.cardUnavailableNoTransfer: Card payment is coming soon — choose yearly payment by bank transfer or contact support@killbottleneck.com.
membership.payerEmail: When paying by card, use the e-mail you created the instance with — we activate your membership based on it.
membership.ownServerByMail: We'll arrange the move to your own server with you by e-mail — we set up the server and move your data. In the app, card payment is currently available for KB Cloud Lite.
membership.changeByMail: We'll arrange a change of plan or billing period with you by e-mail so you don't pay twice — we adjust your existing subscription instead of adding a second one.
membership.transferYearlyOnly: Bank transfer is only available for the yearly plan.
membership.billingFirst: Please fill in and save the billing details above first.
membership.orderReceivedHint: We will e-mail you an invoice for {{amount}} CZK — your plan activates once it is paid. Your data and address stay unchanged.

account.heading: My account
account.displayNameHint: This is how others see you on nodes and in lists. Empty = full name, or e-mail.
account.passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed — please sign in again.
account.passwordRelogin: After changing the password you will be signed out — the old session stops working everywhere on purpose.

data.heading: My data
data.hint: Download one file with everything you can see — projects, tasks, comments, the attachment list, the idea stash, time tracking and contacts. From an export file you can bring projects (with rules) and the idea stash back; comments, attachments and shares stay in the file for reading only.
data.downloadFailed: Downloading the data failed, try again in a moment.
data.uploadBadFile: This is not a killBottleneck export file (killbottleneck.export/1).
data.uploadTooLarge: The file is larger than 50 MB.
data.uploadedSkipped: Projects skipped: {{count}} (organization structure or invalid map).
data.uploadedDropped: Assignments to people who are not here: {{count}} cleared.
